caption:
"You dropped this!" The notebook hopped across the floor and was back with its owner before he reached the door.

Calling out what someone dropped takes one breath, and they walk on without ever missing it.

For whoever calls out what someone dropped.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A hallway with a closed cream door at the far right. A royal blue block figure walks away to the right and a flat orange notebook falls from it to the floor behind it. A ink-black block figure with white eyes at the left says you dropped this. The blue one stops by the door and turns around, its eyes go wide, the notebook hops in an arc across the floor to land at its feet with a small sparkle, and it says oh! thanks. The black one answers any time. Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me calling out what they dropped.
